🔥 flipoff | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a free, browser-based emulation of a split-flap display for decorative or informational purposes on TVs and large monitors.
✨ Key Features: • Realistic split-flap animation with scramble transitions • Authentic mechanical clacking sound • Auto-rotating inspirational quotes • Fullscreen TV mode • Keyboard controls
📖 Summary: FlipOff is a free, open-source web application that emulates the look and feel of a classic mechanical split-flap display, commonly found in airports and train stations. It runs in a web browser, allowing users to turn any TV or monitor into a retro-style information board with realistic animations and sounds.
